source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Include date, time, and location of each emission event.
3. Document the type and volume of pollutants emitted, if known.
4. Record weather conditions at the time of the emissions.
5. Use monitoring data from air quality sensors, if available.
6. Cite relevant regulations and limits for comparative analysis.
7. Describe any observed unauthorized emissions.
8. Note any malfunctioning emission control equipment.
9. Include photographs and videos if possible.
10. Cite interviews with personnel who witnessed the emissions.
11. Summarize the findings in a concise and organized manner.
12. Note any ongoing issues with the facility’s compliance.
13. Provide recommendations for addressing the emissions.
14. Archive raw monitoring data separately for potential future reference.
15. Ensure the accuracy and impartiality of the report.
16. Draft a conclusion summarizing the key findings and implications.
17. Submit the report to the relevant regulatory agency.
18. Maintain copies of the report
